display.purpose: Names the thing on screen only — page titles, panel/flyout headings. Never on a control.

body.purpose: Default UI text: buttons, nav items, body copy.

shadows.name: tile
shadows.purpose: Rail items at rest — the lightest shadow in the system.

shadows.name: tile-active
shadows.purpose: The active rail item — a visibly heavier lift than the resting tile.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The body card and any content card inside it (toolbar card, table card).

shadows.name: flyout
shadows.purpose: Flyout panels and the mobile menu — the strongest shadow, reserved for things that float above the body card.

components.name: Rail Item (rest / hover / active)
components.description: 48px icon-only sidebar rail tile. Rest: white fill, Tile shadow. Hover: mint hover-tint fill, icon turns primary. Active (current page): primary fill, white icon, Tile Active shadow, plus a gold gutter stripe.
components.css: .ds-gl-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; background: #F2F5EF; padding: 12px; } .ds-rail-item { position: relative; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: #ffffff; color: #2C3B2A; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,83,45,.06), 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(44,59,42,.28); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-rail-item:hover, .ds-rail-item.is-hover { background: #EDF3E8; color: #00532D; } .ds-rail-item.is-active { background: #00532D; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(44,59,42,.22), 0 12px 26px -12px rgba(44,59,42,.5); } .ds-rail-item.is-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -8px; top: 12px; width: 3px; height: 24px; border-radius: 2px; background: #C9A96E; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A96E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primair Button
components.description: The one emphasized action on a page (e.g. "+ Nieuwe Factuur"). Primary-green fill, lightens on hover with a soft green glow, darkens on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: #00532D; color: #ffffff; font: 600 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #006638; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgba(0,83,45,.75); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #003d21; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #C9A96E; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #DCE4D7; color: #7C8C7A; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secundair (Sage) Button
components.description: A real but lower-emphasis action next to a Primair one (e.g. "Boeken facturen" beside "+ Nieuwe Factuur"), never destructive. White fill with a sage border at rest; the only button family whose active state uses a different fill than its hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #7A9E6E; background: #ffffff; color: #2F6038; font: 600 12px/1 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #EDF3E8; border-color: #00532D; color: #00532D; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #2F6038; border-color: #2F6038; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #C9A96E; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: #ffffff; border-color: rgba(44,59,42,.12); color: #9AA898; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Flyout Panel
components.description: 262px hover/click panel triggered from a rail item, rendered as a DOM sibling of the rail (never a descendant, to escape its sticky stacking context). Lists links; the one matching the current page gets a primary-fill highlight.
components.html:
Facturatie
BCO Group LN Home-Estate
components.css: .ds-flyout { width: 262px; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,83,45,.06), 0 30px 60px -28px rgba(44,59,42,.45); padding: 10px; } .ds-flyout-title { font: 500 18px/1.25 'Playfair Display', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif; color: #2C3B2A; padding: 8px 10px; } .ds-flyout-link { display: block; padding: 10px; border-radius: 10px; color: #2C3B2A; text-decoration: none; font: 500 15px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-flyout-link:hover { background: #EDF3E8; } .ds-flyout-link.is-current { background: #00532D; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Item (rest / expanded)
components.description: Row in the phone-width hamburger menu panel. Expanded (has an open sub-group) commits fully to the open state: tint background, left border, colored icon/text, heavier weight — not just a rotated chevron.
components.css: .ds-mm-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 13px 10px; border-radius: 10px; color: #2C3B2A; font: 500 15px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-mm-item.is-expanded { background: #D6E5CC; color: #00532D; font-weight: 600; border-left: 3px solid #00532D; }

narrative.overview: The confirmed direction for the CPM admin shell, sourced from a Claude Design wireframe exploration and now replacing the prior near-flat, solid full-height green sidebar system page by page. gl-v2 is composed of distinct floating white cards — an icon-only rail, a body card, hover/click flyout panels — all resting on a warm sage-tinted page (#F2F5EF), each with its own soft ambient shadow. A serif display face (Playfair Display) marks page titles and panel headers, breaking from the prior system's Poppins-only rule; body and label text stay a humanist sans (IBM Plex Sans). Rollout is incremental, one page at a time, not a big-bang switch; only pages ported to gl-v2 render this system while everything else keeps the prior shell until migrated. Any new screen or component should be built in gl-v2 from the outset.
keyCharacteristics: Floating-card identity: every distinct surface (rail, body, flyout, mobile menu) is its own white card with a soft shadow on a tinted page, never a flush/edge-to-edge panel.
Icon-only rail (72px), no persistent text labels — labels surface via tooltip-on-hover and the flyout panel's own heading.
Serif display type for anything that names a page or panel; everything else stays the humanist sans.
8 / 12 / 16px radius scale, one step up from the prior system's 7 / 14 / 16px scale.

rules.name: The Floating-Card Rule
rules.body: Every distinct navigational surface (rail, body, flyout, mobile menu panel) is its own white, shadowed card — never a flush panel sharing an edge with the page background. If two things visually touch with no gap and no shadow break between them, they are the same card, not two.

rules.name: The Naming-Only Serif Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display marks the name of the thing you're looking at — a page, a panel, a person's company. It never appears on a control (button, chip, nav item, form field). Reach for weight in the sans face for everything else.

rules.name: The 12px Inset Rule
rules.body: The whole rail+body composition sits 12px off every viewport edge at desktop width. Nothing in gl-v2 is edge-to-edge except the phone breakpoint's body card, which intentionally loses its radius/shadow and goes flush.

rules.name: The Shadow-Ranks-Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadow strength is not decorative — it's a literal z-order cue. Flyout > Card > Tile Active > Tile. Never give a resting element a stronger shadow than something that's meant to visually float above it.

rules.name: The Flyout-Open-Is-Active Rule
rules.body: A trigger tile gets the exact same visual treatment as the active state for as long as its flyout is open — regardless of whether that item is the actual current-page route. `.is-active` (server-rendered, permanent) and `.is-flyout-open` (JS-toggled, temporary) are separate classes; closing a flyout only ever removes `.is-flyout-open`.

dos: Do keep every new gl-v2 CSS selector scoped under .gl-v2 — no bare-element rules, so it can never leak onto a page that hasn't opted in.
Do use Phosphor Regular icon classes, confirmed rendering, not hand-drawn SVGs.
Do reserve the serif face for names (page titles, panel headings), never for controls.
Do give click handlers on a hover-openable trigger idempotent "ensure open" behavior, not a toggle.

Do treat a dashed-border placeholder as an honest, disclosed "not wired up yet" signal rather than building a fake interactive control with nothing behind it — but suppress it instead if it isn't actually marked as a placeholder.
donts: Don't nest a position:fixed overlay (flyout, mobile menu, backdrop) inside anything with position:sticky — render it as a sibling instead.
Don't rely on the [hidden] attribute alone to hide something that also has an explicit display value in CSS.
Don't wrap @section in an @if in a Razor view — put the @if inside the section body instead.
Don't give two elements the same id just because they do the same thing in two presentations — share a class instead.
Don't duplicate the prior system's Rust/Ochre/Taupe severity tokens or invent a fourth status color here — resolve this when a gl-v2 screen actually needs one.
Don't set a mobile text input's font below 16px — iOS Safari auto-zooms the page on focus below that size.
Don't size a full-screen position:fixed overlay with inset:0 alone — pair it with height:100dvh too.
